name: Lightning Spark
description: Fires a quick, erratic jolt of electricity at a single target.

name: Power Strike
description: A heavy, focused melee attack that channels kinetic force to crush armor.

name: Minor Rejuvenation
description: Calls upon soothing winds to quickly stitch up minor wounds.

name: Piercing Shot
description: Fires a projectile with enough velocity to punch through standard defenses.

name: Tactical Leap
description: Vaults through the air to a new location, causing a shockwave upon landing.

name: Divine Ward
description: Conjures a temporary barrier of holy light to deflect incoming blows.

name: Flame Burst
description: Hurls a sphere of condensed fire that detonates in a fiery explosion.

name: Blade Storm
description: Spins rapidly with a melee weapon, striking all adjacent enemies.

name: Rain of Arrows
description: Fires a volley into the sky that rains down on a target area.

name: Armor-Breaking Strike
description: A calculated, brutal strike designed to sunder the enemy's armor.

name: Shadow Step
description: Melts into the shadows and instantly reappears at a distance, striking nearby foes.

name: Frost Nova
description: Releases a devastating ring of sub-zero frost that chills enemies to the bone.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Unleashes a powerful lightning bolt that arcs between multiple targets.

name: Vicious Cleave
description: A wide, sweeping attack that damages multiple enemies in front of you.

name: Concussive Pommel
description: A blunt strike to the head that disorients and mildly damages the foe.

name: Quick Shot
description: Fires a rapid, low-damage projectile with minimal setup time.

name: Venom Dart
description: Throws a small dart laced with toxic shadow magic.

name: Smoke Veil
description: Smash a vial of ash to create a blinding smoke cloud for evasion.

name: Arcane Missiles
description: Shoots unerring darts of pure arcane energy at a distant target.

name: Frost Bite
description: Freezes the moisture in the air around a target, causing biting cold damage.

name: Divine Smite
description: Channels righteous fury into a devastating close-range magical strike.

name: Prayer of Vigor
description: Utters a prayer that invigorates allies and wards off minor curses.

name: Siphon Life
description: Rips a fraction of the target's life force away using dark magic.

name: Corrosive Acid
description: Hurls a glob of highly corrosive acid that eats through flesh and metal.

name: Brutal Charge
description: Barrels through the battlefield like a juggernaut, trampling foes at the destination.

name: Battering Shield
description: Slams a heavy shield into the enemy to crush bones and break stances.

name: Cull the Weak
description: A lethal, concentrated blow meant to finish off heavily wounded opponents.

name: Shadow Stab
description: A deceptive dagger thrust aimed directly at the enemy's vital organs.

name: Caltrop Field
description: Scatters spiked iron barbs over a wide area to cripple movement.

name: Grappling Hook
description: Fires a hooked chain to rapidly pull yourself toward a distant location.

name: Magma Pillar
description: Erupts the earth beneath the target, spewing searing magma.

name: Water Jet
description: Blasts a high-pressure stream of water capable of denting armor.

name: Gale Force
description: Summons a localized hurricane to stagger and push back enemies.

name: Healing Aura
description: Baths a massive area in divine light, rapidly restoring health.

name: Holy Cleansing
description: Burns away hexes, toxins, and dark magic with pure holy flame.

name: Animate Dead
description: Forces dark magic into a corpse, raising it to fight for you temporarily.

name: Earthshaker Slam
description: Slams the ground with monstrous strength, causing a localized earthquake.

name: Unbreakable Stance
description: Hardens muscles to absolute iron, significantly reducing incoming physical damage.

name: Sniper Shot
description: Takes careful aim to deliver a single, devastating shot from extreme range.

name: Blade Fan
description: Throws a dozen concealed blades outward in a lethal circle.

name: Absolute Invisibility
description: Erases your presence from sight completely to escape or ambush.

name: Falling Meteor
description: Pulls a flaming rock from the sky to crash into the battlefield.

name: Absolute Zero
description: Freezes the ambient temperature to absolute zero, shattering enemy armor.

name: Chronos Shift
description: Bends time to grant you incredible speed and extra actions.

name: Sacred Dome
description: Erects a massive glowing dome that repels dark magic and heals those inside.

name: Noxious Miasma
description: Unleashes a deadly viral cloud that rots enemies from the inside out.

name: Singularity
description: Creates a miniature black hole that crushes enemies under intense gravity.

name: Colossal Smash
description: A legendary physical strike that can shatter fortress walls and giant beasts.

name: Warlord's Roar
description: A terrifying battle cry that bolsters allies and paralyzes weak enemies in fear.

name: Death Blossom
description: A blindingly fast flurry of acrobatic strikes hitting everything around you.

name: Phantom Strike
description: Throws an illusory weapon that becomes terrifyingly real upon impact.

name: Hellfire Cataclysm
description: Calls upon pure hellfire to incinerate an entire quadrant of the battlefield.

name: Wrath of Tsunami
description: Summons a massive tidal wave to crush and drown all foes.

name: Miracle of Life
description: A legendary miracle of divine magic that pulls targets back from the brink of death.

name: Soul Harvest
description: Tears the very souls from enemies, using their energy to deal massive necrotic damage.

name: Godslayer Strike
description: A mythical strike said to be capable of felling immortal beings.

name: Stellar Supernova
description: Unleashes the cosmic power of a dying star directly onto the battlefield.

name: Avatar of Light
description: Temporarily transforms into an ascending being of pure, untouchable holy light.

name: Void Collapse
description: Rips a hole in reality, subjecting enemies to the crushing pressure of the absolute void.

name: Rapid Jab
description: A lightning-fast unarmed punch that strikes before the enemy can react.

name: Dragon Kick
description: A flying martial arts kick wreathed in the flames of a dragon.

name: Sweeping Sweep
description: A low, spinning kick designed to knock the enemy completely off balance.

name: Inner Peace
description: Enters a deep trance, naturally accelerating the body's physical healing.

name: Ember Bolt
description: Shoots a highly concentrated bolt of superheated ash and fire.

name: Stone Armor
description: Coats the caster's skin in an impenetrable layer of magical granite.

name: Wind Slash
description: Swings a weapon to launch a razor-sharp crescent of compressed wind.

name: Shadow Bolt
description: Fires a dark, creeping bolt of necrotic energy at a distant target.

name: Holy Ray
description: Focuses a beam of searing sunlight to burn away impure creatures.

name: Arcane Barrier
description: Surrounds the caster with floating runes that absorb magical impacts.

name: Parry & Riposte
description: Takes a defensive stance, immediately countering the next melee attack.

name: Twin Daggers
description: Executes two impossibly fast stabs with dual-wielded light weapons.

name: Phalanx Wall
description: Plants a shield firmly in the ground, becoming an immovable object.

name: Plasma Burst
description: Superheats the air to unleash a volatile explosion of raw plasma.

name: Glacial Lance
description: Conjures and hurls a massive, razor-sharp stalactite of enchanted ice.

name: Hex of Frailty
description: Curses a foe with dark whispers, draining their physical strength.

name: Solar Beam
description: Calls down a concentrated, blinding pillar of solar energy.

name: Blood Frenzy
description: Flies into a manic rage, ignoring pain to unleash devastating damage.

name: Mirror Image
description: Creates an illusionary double to confuse enemies and dodge attacks.

name: Global Inferno
description: Ignites the very atmosphere, engulfing the battlefield in raging flames.

name: Tectonic Tremor
description: Violently disrupts the earth's crust, crushing enemies beneath stone.

name: Divine Sanctuary
description: Channels the absolute power of the divine to miraculously heal major wounds.

name: Dimension Door
description: Folds space to instantly blink to a new location, releasing arcane energy on arrival.

name: Psychic Scream
description: Unleashes a terrifying mental screech that ruptures the minds of foes.

name: Harpoon Pull
description: Throws a heavy harpoon to violently drag an enemy into melee range.

name: Weapon Disarm
description: A tactical strike aimed specifically at the enemy's hands to ruin their attack.

name: Boiling Blood
description: Uses dark magic to literally boil the blood inside the veins of nearby enemies.

name: Vengeful Wrath
description: Summons angelic weapons that strike down those who oppose the light.

name: Heartseeker
description: A legendary archery technique aimed directly at the center of the enemy's heart.

name: Deep Wound
description: A cruel, twisting slash that causes the target to bleed profusely.

name: Energy Tap
description: Siphons the magical essence out of an opponent to replenish your own.

name: Static Discharge
description: Creates a clinging field of static electricity that shocks anyone who moves.

name: Death Blow
description: The ultimate assassin's technique, designed to kill the target in a single strike.

name: Temporal Freeze
description: Halts the flow of time itself, leaving enemies frozen and helpless.

name: Hundred Cuts
description: A blindingly fast flurry of endless blade strikes that overwhelms any defense.

name: Event Horizon
description: Tears the fabric of reality, creating a vortex that consumes light and matter.

name: Phoenix Flame
description: Summons the mythical flames of the Phoenix to cleanse wounds and restore vitality.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Calls down an apocalyptic shower of massive, flaming meteorites.

name: Arcane Blast
description: Fires a concentrated beam of pure, concussive force magic.

name: Death Ray
description: A terrifying beam of necrotic energy that instantly rots whatever it touches.

name: Cleave
description: A brutal horizontal weapon swing that cuts through multiple foes at once.

name: Power Strike
description: An incredibly heavy, charged weapon strike meant to crush solid armor.

name: Venom Sting
description: A quick jab with a poisoned blade that injects a lethal toxin into the bloodstream.

name: Tail Sweep
description: A massive, spinning strike that mimics the devastating tail swipe of a dragon.

name: Crushing Bite
description: A feral, monstrous attack that clamps down with bone-breaking force.

name: Terrifying Gaze
description: Projects nightmarish illusions into the minds of enemies, causing them to break and flee.

name: Paralyzing Gaze
description: Locks eyes with the target, using psychic magic to freeze their muscles.

name: Hellfire Orb
description: Hurls a condensed sphere of demonic flame that incinerates everything upon detonation.

name: Wing Attack
description: Creates a violent gust of wind by forcefully swinging giant, phantom wings.

name: Droning Sleep
description: Emits a hypnotic, magical frequency that forces enemies into a deep slumber.

name: Spore Cloud
description: Releases a thick cloud of toxic fungal spores that choke and poison the lungs.

name: Stunning Screech
description: Unleashes a deafening, high-pitched scream that disorients and deafens foes.

name: Dominate Mind
description: Overwrites the target's neural pathways, forcing them to obey your commands.

name: Psychic Drain
description: Vampirically leeches the mental energy and sanity out of an opponent.

name: Phantasmal Force
description: Conjures incredibly realistic optical illusions to trick and misdirect the enemy.

name: Raise Zombies
description: Channels mass necrotic energy to pull multiple undead thralls from the earth.

name: Dark Necromancy
description: Fires a concentrated blast of pure, deathly magic that rots living tissue.

name: Blade Flurry
description: Executes an impossibly fast, multi-hit sword combo that shreds through armor.

name: Defensive Parry
description: Adopts a flawless defensive guard to deflect incoming melee attacks with ease.

name: Poison Arrow
description: Fires a deadly sniper arrow dripping with highly concentrated, lethal venom.

name: Wall of Ice
description: Erects a massive, freezing barricade of solid glacial ice.

name: Wall of Fire
description: Summons a roaring wall of untamable flames that incinerates anyone who crosses it.

name: Shadow Breath
description: Exhales a cone of devastating dark magic, mimicking the breath of a shadow dragon.

name: Aura of Darkness
description: Surrounds the caster in an oppressive gloom that blinds and terrifies nearby enemies.

name: Entangling Roots
description: Forces thick, thorny vines to erupt from the ground, binding the legs of foes.

name: Petrifying Gaze
description: Channels the cursed magic of the gorgon to slowly turn flesh into solid stone.

name: Invisibility
description: Bends light around the caster using arcane magic, rendering them completely unseen.

name: Fetid Cloud
description: Releases a disgusting, gaseous cloud of rot and decay.

name: Aerial Swoop
description: Dives from the air with incredible speed, slamming into enemies at the landing site.

name: Flaming Spine
description: Shoots a highly flammable, barbed spine from a distance to impale and burn.

name: Sense Magic
description: Expands the caster's perception to detect hidden traps, illusions, and magical auras.

name: Searing Strike
description: Ignites a melee weapon with roaring flames before delivering a powerful blow.

name: Read Thoughts
description: Invasively breaches the enemy's mind to predict and counter their next move.

name: Displacement
description: Projects a magical illusion that makes the caster appear slightly offset from reality.

name: Tentacle Whip
description: Lashes out with a long, flexible whip to strike enemies just out of sword range.

name: Tremor Slam
description: Pounds the ground to send out shockwaves, knocking adjacent enemies off their feet.

name: Reflect Magic
description: Summons a crystalline barrier that bounces hostile spells back at the caster.

name: Disintegration Ray
description: Fires a thin green beam that turns living matter and armor instantly into dust.

name: Antimagic Field
description: Creates a dead-zone where magical energies simply fizzle out and cease to exist.
